b.x: 01 Name the deviation: a wait that does not buy, a loop of the block, a question that wants your back or the exit from the light.
02 One short no. No paragraph. Explaining continues the interview.
03 Body toward people and cameras: pharmacy, market, station, an open shop. Not the gap, not the stair, not ‘just over there’.
04 If it persists: three turns on a busy street. Do not go home or to the car.
05 Call emergency services. Ask a staff member if you are in a shop. Do not chase. Do not film.
06 After: a message to the family, change the routine you taught, name the own-goal. Shame at leaving early is cheaper than pride.
